pr_title: Rename COREFX_ to DOTNET_TEST_ in test code/scripts

issue_context.title: Rename COREFX_ environment variables used in System.Net.* testing
issue_context.body: There are a bunch of environment variables named "COREFX_", almost all of which are in the System.Net.* tests.  These should be renamed, to "DOTNETLIBRARIES_" or "TEST_" or some such thing.

review_comments: I can live with "DOTNET_TEST" But I would have preferred "DOTNETLIB_TEST".  I think "DOTNET" might be too generic and these variables are specifically about .NET Libraries stuff.

Thanks, David. I don't have a strong preference here, but DOTNET_TEST_ seemed a nice correlary to where we use DOTNET_ for the product src. It's not clear to me there's an advantage to trying to make a distinction here between the VM and the libraries.

Let's go with what I have here. If it becomes an issue, we can certainly change it again.
